summary: Read per-bucket counts for declared count and interval objectives through the SLO series API, CLI, and typed clients

replay.detail: A local derived timestamp index is backfilled once on store open and maintained with claim writes and projection flushes. Authoritative claim bodies and objective selection semantics are unchanged.

schema.detail: Adds the rebuildable local objective timestamp index and pending-work triggers for bounded kind, timestamp-field and event-time seeks.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds GET /v1/slo/series and GET /v1/client/slo/series with required id, from, to and bucket_seconds parameters, plus fractal slo series and Rust, Swift and TypeScript client methods. Timestamps are Unix milliseconds. Existing SLO routes are unchanged.

downtime.detail: No coordinated downtime; the first store open builds the local index before serving reads.

manual.detail: Nothing to configure. Series ranges are half-open, limited to 31 days and 1000 buckets. Intervals report completed sample counts, not percentiles.

recovery.detail: An older build ignores the additive local index and does not expose the series operation.
